README_FIRST: Sanitized template. Each key is a node id_a (32 hex chars = 16 bytes), value is {label, shs_a_ref}. shs_a_ref (64 hex chars = 32 bytes) comes ONLY from the real device at enrollment time (its one-time provisioning-export serial printout) -- it cannot be generated on a host. Register a real node with tools/register_puf_node.py. Real captured values never committed -- see ERRATA.md m1 / Materials Availability.
